To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the trust in cognitive radio networks is a complex and dynamic process, and that the cognitive radio nodes can be trusted by their neighbors based on their behavior and reputation, and that the trust in a network can be measured by the trust in its nodes, and that a trusted network layer can be designed to support trust in cognitive radio network.
the cognitive radio network (or cognitive radio ad hoc network) is a general multilayer heterogeneous network, and that the network layer functions and operations shall be trusted.

(i) we propose the mathematical framework for trust in cognitive radio network, which is based on the concept of trust in human society, (ii) we design the trust management architecture for cognitive radio network, (iii) we design the cognitive radio network layer architecture, (iv) we design the trusted routing algorithm for cognitive radio network.

the development of the trusted network layer structure for cognitive radio networks.
developing the trust framework and trusted network layer architecture for cognitive radio networks.
the design of a trusted network architecture that is suitable for CRN.
